description: Upload files to a file input.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

filePaths.description: List of absolute system file paths to upload.

label.description: Label or placeholder text of the file input.

nodeId.description: CDP backendNodeId of the target <input type='file'> element (fallback).

ref.description: Element ref ID (w:NN) of the target file input from browser_map.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target <input type='file'> element.

name: browser_upload
